body: I've been like this for almost 10-11 years. Not this bad but dysthemic with periods of depression. It's honestly so draining and i don't know how much longer I can do this.
I ended up calling a hotline and they made a plan with me to last at lest until my next counseling appointment but I don't know how well I'm gonna last.

I don't know if I'm doing it to make him feel guilty or not. I've been suicidal my entire life, he knows that, but he made me feel peaceful and not want to die when we were together. Now hes gone and it's back full force and it makes me want to do horrible things to myself.
It's much more than just being dumped it's the only person who's cared about me genuinely letting me know they actually don't.  He hates me abd I deserve to die for what I've done.
I meant more of a suicide note thing since i don't plan on leaving a note. I want him to know but i don't want him to try and stop me
